title: Terms & Conditions
sections: Your agreement

These Terms govern your use of Credit Regulator Pro a division of COMPND SYSTEMS LTD. The price, renewal details and included access shown before you pay form part of your purchase. These Terms do not remove consumer rights that the law does not allow us to waive.
What the service provides

CRP helps you review your credit report and supported reporting issues. Subscribers can compare later reports and choose issues for a correction or verification packet. You review and approve the selected letter and supporting copies before downloading. You decide whether and where to send them. CRP does not sign or send packets for you.
Your account and documents

Use accurate account information and protect your sign-in details and saved recovery key. Upload only reports and documents you are entitled to use. You keep ownership of your uploads and allow CRP to process them to provide and protect this service. Review your packet before using it.
Results

Results depend on your report, its quality and the checks supported by the service. A result does not mean every possible error was found. We do not promise a score change, correction, deletion, bureau response or particular outcome.
Access and payment

Free access provides the existing summary and limited preview. One-time access unlocks the complete assessment, report evidence and assessment download for your selected report. Subscriptions include the existing full assessment, consumer-controlled packet functions, report history and later-report comparison. A completed purchase unlocks the existing assessment without another upload.
Currency and prices

Your IP selects CAD, USD, AUD or GBP starting prices. Other or unknown locations see US prices. You may change payment currency before paying. Fixed native prices, taxes and the amount due are shown before payment. Your selected charge currency does not guarantee the currency of merchant bank settlement.
Renewal, cancellation and credit

Monthly and yearly subscriptions renew until cancelled. Cancel renewal in your account to stop the next charge. Access normally lasts through the paid period, subject to refunds, chargebacks, payment failure and applicable law. Account deletion is not a substitute for cancelling renewal. Eligible upgrade credit applies only in the same charged currency; credit and the first payment are shown before confirmation.
Use and changes

Do not access another person’s account, bypass security or payment controls, upload malicious content, interfere with the service or misrepresent approval. We may reasonably restrict misuse. Interruptions and errors can occur. We will communicate material changes as required by law; changes do not remove rights already earned under a purchase.
Support
For billing errors, cancellation questions, refunds or these Terms, email support@creditregulatorpro.com.
Australian consumer guarantees

Services must meet applicable Australian Consumer Law guarantees, including due care and skill. Where guarantees are not met, you may be entitled to a remedy such as fixing the problem, cancellation, refund or compensation. These guarantees cannot be excluded by these Terms.
